description: Inputs, derived features and targets used by the blocking models. Units in kelvin unless stated.

grid.longitude: 72 values, 0, 5, ..., 355 degrees east, for B and blocking measures; native theta grid has 320 longitudes (1.125 degrees)
grid.latitude: 160 Gaussian latitudes (N80); the eigenbasis model uses 46 of them, 25.2 to 75.7 N, restricted further to the cells that carry B weight

time.modeled: daily means, December to February; a winter is labeled by the year of its December

raw_inputs.name: pt
raw_inputs.description: Potential temperature (theta) on the 2 PVU surface

raw_inputs.name: u, v
raw_inputs.description: Eastward and northward wind, on 2 PVU or at 300 hPa
raw_inputs.used: only to locate the central latitude

raw_inputs.name: pres, z, q, o3
raw_inputs.description: Pressure, geopotential, humidity, ozone on 2 PVU

derived_features.name: CBL
derived_features.transformation: Fixed curve digitized from Tyrlis & Hoskins Fig. 1; a seasonal version comes from the latitude of maximum variance of 2-6 day band-passed wind

derived_features.name: B
derived_features.description: Blocking index by day and longitude
derived_features.transformation: Mean theta over [CBL, CBL + 15] minus mean over [CBL - 15, CBL], daily mean. notebooks/B Value Computation.ipynb averages over a 5-degree longitude box and takes the maximum over CBL - 4, CBL, CBL + 4; 2_dim/ uses CBL only. See evaluation_plan.md, open item 1

derived_features.name: delta_B
derived_features.transformation: B minus its mean or median at that longitude

derived_features.name: theta_anomaly
derived_features.description: Theta anomaly for the eigenbasis model
derived_features.transformation: Daily theta minus training-winter calendar-day climatology

derived_features.name: eigenbasis_coordinates
derived_features.description: Coordinates of the theta anomaly in the eigenvectors of its day-to-day changes
derived_features.transformation: Eigenvectors of the covariance of daily changes over training winters

targets.name: SB
targets.definition: LIB at 3 consecutive longitudes inside the 45-degree sector centered on the longitude

targets.name: SBE
targets.definition: SB at the longitude on that day and the previous 4 days
